title: Grave Moss
wikitext:
'''Grave Moss''' is an [[herb]] that can be gathered with [[Herbalism]] (120). The moss can be found around gravesites in places such as the [[Kodo Graveyard]] in [[Desolace]], [[Ironbeard's Tomb]] in the [[Wetlands]], [[Scarlet Monastery]] graveyard in [[Tirisfal Glades]], and the [[Raven Hill]] graveyard in [[Duskwood]].
